method: Each homepage image is a crop of a genuine Parchmatte 1.2.2 (29) capture: panels cut from the uploaded App Store screenshots (headlines, labels and decoration left out), plus one native menu capture. Resized with macOS sips, ancillary PNG metadata removed with strip_png_metadata.py. Nothing retouched or retyped. Each image ships at 960x640 and 480x320 (same 3:2 crop).
